baselineExclusionRule: Every standards package not explicitly listed in stablePackages remains outside the 1.0.0 stable package promise for this release candidate, even when its paths remain repository compatibility surfaces.

breakingChanges: Full completion-result v2 conformance now combines structural JSON Schema validation with completion semantic validation: executed passed or failed validations identify one exact retry-ledger action, reset authorization identifies and chronologically bridges adjacent sequences, terminal dispositions prohibit later actions, and accepted RFC 3339 timestamps retain arbitrary fractional precision.

Existing Site Reliability Engineering and Testing and Quality Engineering adopters must migrate to the strengthened readiness, scaling, and contextual performance-test decision and evidence contracts, including separate performance-test execution states and outcomes.
Existing canonical-profile adopters must select Product Management or User Experience when the documented conditional predicate is satisfied.

All existing Agent Working Method adopters must adopt GOV-WORK-011 through GOV-WORK-014: the same objective or blocker retry budget spans the whole active task or change and all tools, tasks, sessions, agents, and strategies; exhaustion is terminal, with reset only after the prior sequence stops and reports, an accountable requester or owner separately authorizes it, and evidence records a material blocker or relevant scope or system-state change.

Existing completion-report template adopters and completion-result producers must migrate to required executionDiscipline evidence and schemaVersion 2.0.0; repository validation routes omitted versions to the current major, retained v1 records require explicit schemaVersion 1.0.0 there, failed or indeterminate budgeted attempts cannot claim objective completion, and historical v1 completion records remain supported.
requiredActions: Run tools/validate-schemas/validate_schemas.py for current completion-result v2 records; require objectiveId and actionId on each executed passed or failed validation and correlate its result to that one exact retry-ledger action; require resetAuthorization.priorSequenceId to equal the immediately prior unresolved sequence and authorizedAt to fall between that terminal end and the new sequence start; require every preTerminalNonConsumingActions entry to end no later than the unresolved terminal attempt starts; prohibit every other action after objective completion; and preserve arbitrary fractional precision when comparing every RFC 3339 date-time accepted by structural validation.
Update the recorded repository source from v0.10.0 to the reviewed 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate when deliberately evaluating the release candidate.
Re-run repository or project validation after changing the pinned standards source.

Migrate existing SRE and Testing package selections to the strengthened readiness, scaling, and per-test execution-state, outcome, accountability, and safety evidence contracts; record scaling validation that misses authorized criteria as Failed rather than unresolved, and do not report an overall scaling strategy Verified until every applicable scaling area is Verified with no Applicable, NotRun, Blocked, or Failed area, or performance/scalability validated until every applicable test type is Tested with outcome Pass.
Re-evaluate every selected canonical profile against the conditional Product Management and User Experience predicates and record either the selected overlay or a scope-specific omission rationale.

For a selected User Experience overlay, record validation state separately from per-method and overall outcome and do not report UX validated unless the overall outcome is Pass and every applicable method and claim succeeds for the exact version and representative conditions.
Treat only languages/csharp as a stable package commitment; do not infer stable maturity for baseline packages.

Add GOV-WORK-011 through GOV-WORK-014 and retain GOV-WORK-003 scope discipline; track the same objective or underlying blocker across the whole active task or change and all tools, tasks, sessions, agents, and strategies; count one budget-consuming attempt as any execution action directed at the objective or blocker, ending after observable effects are reconciled with a Failed or Indeterminate result, and count each further execution action as a retry even within the same command sequence, plan, workflow, tool, agent, or strategy; require every retry to record a causally relevant material change and why that change creates a concrete reason it may succeed, because generic justification, rerunning, changing tools or agents, or delegating the same approach is insufficient; Failed or Indeterminate read-only execution for the same objective or blocker consumes budget, while successful evidence-only discovery, actual-state reconciliation, and non-state-changing validation are non-consuming; record a subsequent Successful objective-clearing action at its current retry position and end the objective or blocker; stop all further execution attempts and report unresolved when the initial attempt plus two retries are exhausted, and reset only after the prior sequence stops and reports, separate authorization from an accountable requester or owner, recorded material blocker or relevant scope or system-state change, and causal rationale; delegated work records meaningful value, failure evidence, blocker, retry count, unresolved state, and preserved boundaries; carry failure, reconciliation, progress, and delegation handoff evidence.

Migrate current completion-report template and completion-result records to schemaVersion 2.0.0 and complete executionDiscipline evidence; repository-discovered records without schemaVersion select the current major, so explicitly mark retained v1 records as schemaVersion 1.0.0; use one retryLedger map keyed by objective, store each objective's failedOrIndeterminateOutcomes array inside that objective's ledger, and store delegationHandoff inside every prior and current sequence, with the outcome array non-empty exactly when the same ledger contains a Failed or Indeterminate attempt, so the same objective cannot be split across maps; require each retry action to record materialChange and causalRationale; organize each objective ledger as repeatable per-objective sequences, preserve the prior sequence stop/report by storing only sequences that actually ended reported-unresolved under priorUnresolvedSequences, and store exactly one latest sequence under currentSequence; when prior sequences exist, require the current sequence to record separate accountable authorization, the material blocker or relevant scope or system-state change, and causal rationale; record successful non-consuming discovery, reconciliation, and validation actions as ledger rows and allow an evidence-only sequence to omit attempts only when nonConsumingActions is non-empty; in a sequence ending reported-unresolved, store successful evidence gathered before the stop in preTerminalNonConsumingActions and prohibit nonConsumingActions so further action requires a separately authorized reset sequence, while other sequences leave the pre-terminal array empty; require at least one passed validation before using validated status; require every executed passed or failed validation to use objectiveId and actionId to identify one unique ledger action with a compatible result; require retry-authorized only when the corresponding next retry is present; prohibit every later action or sequence after objective completion; require explicit per-sequence delegationHandoff.delegated and, when true, use the containing objective ledger's outcomes as authoritative failure evidence and require meaningfulValue, blocker, unresolvedState, and boundariesPreserved true; require retryCount to equal that same sequence's actual retry depth and preserve a prior sequence's handoff after an authorized reset; retain historical v1 completion records under schemas/v1/completion-result.schema.json.
